title: Put a Change Request in Order
prompt: The administrator must deploy a security patch in production. Order the following steps correctly, from opening the request to closure.

items.label: Open the change ticket with the owner and stakeholders
Perform impact analysis: services, dependencies, and security controls
Present the package to the CAB and obtain approval
Schedule the maintenance window and announce the downtime
Execute tests and document the results
Deploy to production with the backout plan ready to execute
Verify the service after restart and decide, if needed, on backout or fail forward
Update diagrams, policies/procedures, and version control, then close the ticket

explain: The expected order is: ticket and ownership -> impact analysis -> CAB approval -> maintenance window -> testing -> implementation with backout -> verification/decision -> documentation and closure. An untested backout plan or omitted documentation are the most common mistakes.
